title: Embeddings and Utilities
summary: This module provides core functionalities for generating text embeddings, managing concurrency, and handling agent response streams, alongside various general-purpose utilities.

nodes.label: Embedder
nodes.title: Embedder Interface
nodes.description: High-level interface for generating text embeddings from various models, handling settings and instrumentation.

nodes.label: Embedding Model Base
nodes.title: Abstract Embedding Model
nodes.description: Abstract base class defining the common interface for all embedding models, including methods for embedding and token counting.

nodes.label: Wrapper Embedding Model
nodes.title: Model Wrapper
nodes.description: Allows wrapping other embedding models to modify or extend their behavior, such as for caching or logging.

nodes.label: Test Embedding Model
nodes.title: Mock Embedding Model
nodes.description: A mock embedding model used for testing purposes, returning deterministic embeddings and tracking settings.

nodes.label: Cohere Bedrock Handler
nodes.title: Cohere Bedrock Integration
nodes.description: Prepares requests and parses responses specifically for Cohere embedding models hosted on AWS Bedrock.

nodes.label: Amazon Nova Bedrock Handler
nodes.title: Amazon Nova Bedrock Integration
nodes.description: Prepares requests and parses responses for Amazon Nova embedding models on AWS Bedrock.

nodes.label: Amazon Titan Bedrock Handler
nodes.title: Amazon Titan Bedrock Integration
nodes.description: Prepares requests and parses responses for Amazon Titan embedding models on AWS Bedrock.

nodes.label: Concurrency Limiter
nodes.title: Concurrency Management
nodes.description: Manages and limits the number of concurrent operations, tracking waiting tasks for observability.

nodes.label: Agent Stream
nodes.title: Agent Response Stream
nodes.description: Manages streaming responses from an AI agent, including output validation, usage tracking, and cancellation.

nodes.label: Run in Executor
nodes.title: Async Executor Utility
nodes.description: Utility to execute synchronous functions in a thread pool executor asynchronously, handling context propagation.

nodes.label: Get Event Loop
nodes.title: Asyncio Event Loop Access
nodes.description: Utility to retrieve the current asyncio event loop or create a new one if none is running.

nodes.label: Get Union Arguments
nodes.title: Type Hint Utility
nodes.description: Utility to extract arguments from a Python `Union` type hint, unwrapping annotated types.

nodes.label: Format as XML
nodes.title: XML Serialization
nodes.description: Utility to serialize various Python objects into a human-readable XML string format, useful for LLM prompts.

nodes.label: Deprecated Decorator
nodes.title: Deprecation Marker
nodes.description: A decorator used to mark callable properties as deprecated, providing a warning message upon access.

nodes.label: Map Cohere Usage
nodes.title: Cohere Usage Mapper
nodes.description: Maps Cohere embedding response metadata to a standardized `RequestUsage` format for tracking.

nodes.label: Map Google Usage
nodes.title: Google Usage Mapper
nodes.description: Maps Google embedding response metadata to a standardized `RequestUsage` format, noting token count availability.

nodes.label: Map OpenAI Usage
nodes.title: OpenAI Usage Mapper
nodes.description: Maps OpenAI embedding response metadata to a standardized `RequestUsage` format, handling missing usage data.

nodes.label: Map VoyageAI Usage
nodes.title: VoyageAI Usage Mapper
nodes.description: Maps VoyageAI embedding response metadata to a standardized `RequestUsage` format.

nodes.label: Request Usage
nodes.title: Resource Usage Data
nodes.description: Data structure for tracking token and other resource consumption from model requests across different providers.

nodes.label: Embedding Result
nodes.title: Embedding Output Data
nodes.description: Data structure containing generated embeddings, input texts, input type, and associated usage metadata.

nodes.label: Model Response
nodes.title: Model Output Snapshot
nodes.description: Represents a snapshot of a model's streaming response, including content parts, tool calls, and current state.

nodes.label: Embedding Settings
nodes.title: Embedding Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration settings for embedding models, such as output dimensions, truncation modes, or input types.

nodes.label: Usage (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Deprecated Usage Alias
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for `RunUsage`, used for tracking resource consumption within a run.

nodes.label: Anyio Capacity Limiter
nodes.title: Anyio Concurrency
nodes.description: An external library component used by ConcurrencyLimiter for managing concurrent task execution capacity.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry Tracer
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Tracing
nodes.description: An external component for distributed tracing and observability, used by ConcurrencyLimiter for span creation.

groups.label: Embedding Core
groups.title: Core Embedding Components
groups.description: Central components for managing and interacting with embedding models.

groups.label: Embedding Provider Handlers
groups.title: Provider-Specific Embedding Logic
groups.description: Components responsible for integrating with specific embedding model providers like AWS Bedrock.

groups.label: Usage Mapping
groups.title: Model Usage Translation
groups.description: Functions that translate provider-specific usage metrics into a common `RequestUsage` format.

groups.label: Concurrency & Streaming
groups.title: Concurrency and Stream Management
groups.description: Components for controlling concurrent operations and managing asynchronous agent response streams.

groups.label: General Utilities
groups.title: Common Utility Functions
groups.description: A collection of general-purpose utility functions for asynchronous operations, type introspection, and data formatting.

groups.label: Data Structures
groups.title: Module Data Structures
groups.description: Key data structures used across the module for representing embeddings, model responses, and usage information.
